Building collapses in Maharashtra and Delhi, resulting in multiple fatalities

Multiple building collapses have occurred across India, including in Maharashtra's Parbhani and Delhi's Rohini area, leading to fatalities and injuries. In Parbhani, the roof of an under-construction temple collapsed, killing five people. In Delhi, a four-story building collapsed, resulting in at least three deaths and several people trapped, with rescue operations concluding. The cause of the Delhi collapse is being investigated, with heavy rains mentioned as a potential factor.
